B1.title: Licensing Requirements
B1.html: (B)1A person cannot be a Trainer, a Jockey, a Valet or a Jockey’s Agent without having a Licence permitting them to do so issued by the BHA, or equivalent licence issued by another Recognised Racing Authority.
